# superset_theme (Resource)

Manages a theme of the Superset UI, on Superset 6: a JSON document of design tokens that a `superset_dashboard` applies with `theme_id`, and that can be the default or the dark theme of the whole instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "superset_theme" "corporate" {
  name = "Corporate"
  json_data = jsonencode({
    token = {
      colorPrimary = "#1f77b4"
      fontFamily   = "Inter, sans-serif"
    }
  })

  # The default theme of the whole instance.
  system_default = true
}

# A dashboard that applies another theme.
resource "superset_theme" "executive" {
  name      = "Executive"
  json_data = jsonencode({ token = { colorPrimary = "#2a9d8f" } })
}

resource "superset_dashboard" "board" {
  title    = "Board"
  theme_id = superset_theme.executive.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `json_data` (String) JSON document with the design tokens of the theme, as the theme editor exports it, for example `{"token": {"colorPrimary": "#1f77b4"}}`.
- `name` (String) Name of the theme.

### Optional

- `system_dark` (Boolean) Whether the theme is the dark theme of the instance. Only one theme is. Defaults to `false`.
- `system_default` (Boolean) Whether the theme is the default theme of the instance. Only one theme is, so setting it on a theme takes the place of the previous one. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the theme.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the theme, as export bundles reference it.
